title: Don't ...! You mustn't ...!
description: A bilingual picture-and-prompt lesson: nine numbered pictures (aspirins, medicine, a doctor, matches, the library, noise, a fast car, the window, a vase) each paired with a 'Don't ...! / You mustn't ...!' caption, followed by workbook practice on giving permission answers and negative short forms, plus grammar on rewriting Don't sentences with mustn't/must. 看图提示课：9幅编号插图（阿司匹林、药、医生、火柴、图书馆、噪音、快车、窗户、花瓶）各配一条「不要……！」提示，配合教材 permission 回答、否定缩略式练习，以及用 mustn't/must 改写 Don't 句的语法练习。
answer_note: The Lesson 64 section of the supplied workbook key (img/key-063-067.jpg) covers only exercises A (items 2-5), B and C; the textbook written-exercise answers are not in the workbook key, so they are constructed from the printed examples and labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 64 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 496-497). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

lines.text: Don't take any aspirins! You mustn't take any aspirins!
lines.translation: 不要吃阿司匹林！你不应该吃阿司匹林！

lines.text: Don't take this medicine! You mustn't take this medicine!
lines.translation: 不要吃这种药！你不应该吃这种药！

lines.text: Don't call the doctor! You mustn't call the doctor!
lines.translation: 不要打电话叫医生！你不应该打电话叫医生！

lines.text: Don't play with matches! You mustn't play with matches!
lines.translation: 不要玩火柴！你不应该玩火柴！

lines.text: Don't talk in the library! You mustn't talk in the library!
lines.translation: 不要在图书馆里谈话！你不应该在图书馆里谈话！

lines.text: Don't make a noise! You mustn't make a noise!
lines.translation: 不要弄出噪音！你不应该弄出噪音！

lines.text: Don't drive so quickly! You mustn't drive so quickly!
lines.translation: 不要开这么快！你不应该开这么快！

lines.text: Don't lean out of the window! You mustn't lean out of the window!
lines.translation: 不要把身体探出窗外！你不应该把身体探出窗外！

lines.text: Don't break that vase! You mustn't break that vase!
lines.translation: 不要打破那个花瓶！你不应该打破那个花瓶！

lesson.title: Written exercise A Rewrite these sentences using Jimmy.
lesson.instruction: Rewrite these sentences using Jimmy. 改写以下句子，用 Jimmy 作主语。
lesson.translation: Rewrite each sentence with Jimmy as the subject.
lesson.context: The printed example rewrites 'I mustn't take any aspirins.' as 'Jimmy mustn't take any aspirins.' (I → Jimmy, keeping the rest of the sentence unchanged); items 1-6 follow the same pattern. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: I mustn't take any aspirins.
questions.answer: Jimmy mustn't take any aspirins.

questions.prompt: I am better now but I mustn't get up yet.
questions.answer: Jimmy is better now but he mustn't get up yet.

questions.prompt: I have a cold and I must stay in bed.
questions.answer: Jimmy has a cold and he must stay in bed.

questions.prompt: I can get up for two hours each day.
questions.answer: Jimmy can get up for two hours each day.

questions.prompt: I often read in bed.
questions.answer: Jimmy often reads in bed.

questions.prompt: I listen to the stereo, too.
questions.answer: Jimmy listens to the stereo, too.

questions.prompt: I don't feel ill now.
questions.answer: Jimmy doesn't feel ill now.

lesson.title: Written exercise B Complete these sentences.
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences. 模仿例句完成以下句子。
lesson.translation: Complete each sentence following the example: fill the blank, then rewrite with 'You mustn't ...'.
lesson.context: The printed example shows 'Don't eat rich food!' → 'You mustn't eat rich food!'; the nine items correspond to the nine picture captions on page 127 and each has the same two-part answer. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: ______ eat rich food!
questions.answer:
Don't eat rich food!
You mustn't eat rich food!

questions.prompt: ______ take any aspirins!
questions.answer:
Don't take any aspirins!
You mustn't take any aspirins!

questions.prompt: ______ take this medicine!
questions.answer:
Don't take this medicine!
You mustn't take this medicine!

questions.prompt: ______ call the doctor!
questions.answer:
Don't call the doctor!
You mustn't call the doctor!

questions.prompt: ______ play with matches!
questions.answer:
Don't play with matches!
You mustn't play with matches!

questions.prompt: ______ talk in the library!
questions.answer:
Don't talk in the library!
You mustn't talk in the library!

questions.prompt: ______ make a noise!
questions.answer:
Don't make a noise!
You mustn't make a noise!

questions.prompt: ______ drive so quickly!
questions.answer:
Don't drive so quickly!
You mustn't drive so quickly!

questions.prompt: ______ lean out of the window!
questions.answer:
Don't lean out of the window!
You mustn't lean out of the window!

questions.prompt: ______ break that vase!
questions.answer:
Don't break that vase!
You mustn't break that vase!

practice.title: A Can I ...? You mustn't ...! and You must ...!
practice.instruction: These people are asking permission to do things. Write answers with the prompts. 以下各句用于表示请求别人的允许，根据提示作答。
practice.translation: Answer each permission request with 'No, don't ...!', 'You mustn't ...!' and 'You must ...', following the example.
practice.context: The boxed example asks 'Can I get up?' and answers 'No, don't get up. You mustn't get up. You must stay in bed.' Each item is one answer field: don't-sentence, mustn't-sentence and the must-sentence from the prompt, in that order. The supplied key covers items 2-5; item 1's answer follows the boxed example.

questions.prompt: Can I make a noise? (Keep quiet)
questions.answer: No, don't make a noise. You mustn't make a noise. You must keep quiet.

questions.prompt: Can I eat any meat? (eat fruit and vegetables)
questions.answer: No, don't eat any meat. You mustn't eat any meat. You must eat fruit and vegetables.

questions.prompt: Can I take any medicine? (drink water)
questions.answer: No, don't take any medicine. You mustn't take any medicine. You must drink water.

questions.prompt: Can I read a newspaper? (read a good book)
questions.answer: No, don't read a newspaper. You mustn't read a newspaper. You must read a good book.

questions.prompt: Can I watch television? (listen to the radio)
questions.answer: No, don't watch television. You mustn't watch television. You must listen to the radio.

practice.title: B Short forms
practice.instruction: Write these with negative short forms. 写出表示否定的缩略形式。
practice.translation: Rewrite each sentence using a negative short form.

questions.prompt: You must not eat any rich food.
questions.answer: You mustn't eat any rich food.

questions.prompt: She does not drive very quickly.
questions.answer: She doesn't drive very quickly.

questions.prompt: I do not like medicine.
questions.answer: I don't like medicine.

questions.prompt: They are not going to school.
questions.answer: They aren't going to school.

questions.prompt: She is not cooking a meal.
questions.answer: She isn't cooking a meal.

practice.title: C Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: For each situation, write what you would say.
practice.context: Situational prompts; the supplied key gives model answers.

questions.prompt: Someone says: 'Can I talk to you?' How do you agree?
questions.answer: Certainly. / Of course.

questions.prompt: Your sister is ill. You call the doctor and ask him to see her. What do you say?
questions.answer: Can you (come and) see my sister, please?

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=197
grammar.title: I. Rewrite the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。
grammar.instruction: Rewrite the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: Rewrite each 'Don't ...!' pair as 'You mustn't ...!' / 'You must ...!', following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=496
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The exercise continues on grammar PDF page 198.

questions.prompt: Don't put the glasses on the refrigerator. Put them on the table.
questions.answer: You mustn't put the glasses on the refrigerator. You must put them on the table.

questions.prompt: Don't put the dishes here. Put them on the shelf.
questions.answer: You mustn't put the dishes here. You must put them on the shelf.

questions.prompt: Don't go to school by bike today. Go to school by bus.
questions.answer: You mustn't go to school by bike today. You must go to school by bus.

questions.prompt: Don't eat meat. Eat fresh fruit.
questions.answer: You mustn't eat meat. You must eat fresh fruit.

questions.prompt: Don't look at your books. Look at the blackboard, please.
questions.answer: You mustn't look at your books. You must look at the blackboard.

questions.prompt: Don't watch television. Do your homework.
questions.answer: You mustn't watch television. You must do your homework.

questions.prompt: Don't drive so quickly. Drive slowly.
questions.answer: You mustn't drive so quickly. You must drive slowly.

questions.prompt: Don't talk in the library. Read your books.
questions.answer: You mustn't talk in the library. You must read your books.

questions.prompt: Don't see a dentist. See a doctor.
questions.answer: You mustn't see a dentist. You must see a doctor.

questions.prompt: Don't play with matches. Play in the garden.
questions.answer: You mustn't play with matches. You must play in the garden.

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=198
grammar.title: II. Give correct replies to the sentences, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词写出下列句子的对应句。
grammar.instruction: Give correct replies to the sentences, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词写出下列句子的对应句。
grammar.translation: Give a 'so ...' reply to each sentence using the cue in brackets, following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=497
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable.

questions.prompt: I don't feel well. (stay at home/today)
questions.answer: I don't feel well, so I'm staying at home today.

questions.prompt: My son has a temperature. (must/take him to the doctor's)
questions.answer: My son has a temperature, so I must take him to the doctor's.

questions.prompt: It's raining very hard. (I/go to work by taxi)
questions.answer: It's raining very hard, so I'm going to work by taxi.

questions.prompt: He feels cold. (must/put on more clothes)
questions.answer: He feels cold, so he must put on more clothes.

questions.prompt: I must catch the train. (taxi driver/drive quickly)
questions.answer: I must catch the train, so the taxi driver must drive quickly.

questions.prompt: It's always warm in Greece in autumn. (tourists/often go there then)
questions.answer: It's always warm in Greece in autumn, so tourists often go there then.

questions.prompt: The lettuces are not fresh today. (I/not want them)
questions.answer: The lettuces are not fresh today, so I do not want them.

questions.prompt: His car is in the garage today. (go to work by bus)
questions.answer: His car is in the garage today, so he is going to work by bus.
